Callout.Name: Suspected Vehicle Bomb
Callout.Message: Vehicle reported with wiring visible under the dashboard.
Callout.Advisory: Nobody in or near the vehicle, caller keeping people back.

Script.Line: The wires were hanging down by the pedals.
I did not touch anything. I called you from across the road.
I do not know whose it is. It has been there since yesterday.

Lines.Approach: Wiring under the dash and nobody near it. Do not touch the car - keep the street clear.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
